investigation_notes.Alert Name: Microsoft Defender: Potentially Unwanted Application Prevented
investigation_notes.Description: PUA:MacKeeper was prevented on host WKSTN-DEV-772. The detected process chain (idea64.exe -> java.exe) and the Gradle-related file path appear consistent with normal software development activity for the user. Hash reputation search did not return results and there are no related events or external communications, supporting a low likelihood of active compromise; the alert is considered Low Priority.
